svg.text: HOW TO MAKE IT AND HOW IT FITS

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Cut four lugs from 15 mm plate; drill each 21 dia for the pin

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Two lugs on the shell ring at its far edge (+Y), 395 apart

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: vertically, the upper one 190 above the axis

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Two lugs on the door ring, each 2 mm above a shell-ring lug

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Pin hole centres 16 in front of the shell ring face and 515

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: out from the axis; set them on one vertical line with a rod

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Pin: 20 dia bar 450 long, head on top, collar under the lowest lug

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Slot the door lugs' holes 3 mm toward the axis so the door

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: can settle evenly on the gasket

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: the door swings freely and closes square on the gasket
